templates.pat: The Bioconductor project aims to develop and share open source software for precise and repeatable analysis of biological data.{{1}} We foster an inclusive and collaborative community of developers and data scientists.

templates.pat: The Bioconductor {{1}} is updated twice each year, and is appropriate for most users. Each Bioconductor release is designed to work with a specific version of R, with the relationship summarized in {{2}}. There is also a {{3}}, to which new features and packages are added prior to incorporation in the release. A large number of {{4}} provide pathway, organism, microarray and other annotations.
templates.zh: Bioconductor 的{{1}}每年更新两次，适合大多数用户。每个 Bioconductor 版本都与特定的 R 版本配套，二者对应关系汇总于{{2}}。此外还有一个{{3}}，新功能与新软件包会先进入其中，随后才纳入正式版本。大量{{4}}提供通路、物种、微阵列及其他注释。

templates.pat: The Bioconductorproject started in 2001 and is overseen by a {{1}}. A {{2}} and a {{3}} of key participants meets monthly to support the Bioconductor mission by coordinating training and outreach activities, developing strategies to ensure long-term technical suitability of core infrastructure, and to identify and enable funding strategies for long-term viability. A {{4}} including external experts provides annual guidance and accountability.
templates.zh: Bioconductor 项目始于 2001 年，由{{1}}监督管理。由关键参与者组成的{{2}}与{{3}}每月开会，通过协调培训与外展活动、制定确保核心基础设施长期技术适用性的策略，并确定及促成保障长期可持续性的资助策略，来支持 Bioconductor 的使命。{{4}}包含外部专家，每年提供指导与问责。

templates.pat: Most Bioconductor components are distributed as {{1}}. The functional scope of {{2}} includes the analysis of DNA microarray, sequence, flow, SNP, and other genetic or genomic data.

templates.pat: Each {{1}} contains one or more {{2}}, documents that provide a textual, task-oriented description of the package's functionality. Vignettes come in several forms. Many are "HowTo"s that demonstrate how a particular task can be accomplished with that package's software. Others provide a more thorough overview of the package or discuss general issues related to the package.
templates.zh: 每个 {{1}} 包含一个或多个{{2}}，这些文档以文字、面向任务的方式说明软件包的功能。简介文档有多种形式。许多是「HowTo」，演示如何用该软件包完成某项任务；另一些则对软件包做更全面的概述，或讨论与该软件包相关的一般问题。

templates.pat: The Bioconductor project provides access to powerful statistical and graphical methods for the analysis of genomic data. {{1}} address {{2}} for analysis of oligonucleotide arrays, sequence analysis, flow cytometry. and other high-throughput genomic data. The {{3}} itself provides implementations for a broad range of state-of-the-art statistical and graphical techniques, including linear and non-linear modeling, cluster analysis, prediction, resampling, survival analysis, and time-series analysis.
templates.zh: Bioconductor 项目为基因组数据分析提供强大的统计与图形方法。{{1}}面向{{2}}，涵盖寡核苷酸微阵列分析、序列分析、流式细胞术以及其他高通量基因组数据。{{3}}本身实现了广泛的前沿统计与图形技术，包括线性与非线性建模、聚类分析、预测、重抽样、生存分析和时间序列分析。

templates.pat: The Bioconductor project provides software for associating microarray and other genomic data in real time with biological metadata from web databases such as GenBank, Entrez genes and PubMed ({{1}} package). Functions are also provided for incorporating the results of statistical analysis in HTML reports with links to annotation web resources. Software tools are available for assembling and processing genomic annotation data, from databases such as GenBank, the Gene Ontology Consortium, Entrez genes, UniGene, the UCSC Human Genome Project ({{2}} package). {{3}} are distributed to provide mappings between different probe identifiers (e.g. Affy IDs, Entrez genes, PubMed). Customized annotation libraries can also be assembled.
templates.zh: Bioconductor 项目提供的软件可将微阵列及其他基因组数据与来自 GenBank、Entrez 基因、PubMed 等网络数据库的生物学元数据实时关联（{{1}} 软件包）。此外还提供函数，用于把统计分析结果纳入带有注释网络资源链接的 HTML 报告。也有工具可用于汇集与处理基因组注释数据，来源包括 GenBank、基因本体联盟、Entrez 基因、UniGene、UCSC 人类基因组计划（{{2}} 软件包）。分发的{{3}}在不同探针标识符（例如 Affy ID、Entrez 基因、PubMed）之间提供映射，也可以构建自定义注释库。

templates.pat: The Bioconductor project has developed a program of {{1}} on software and statistical methods for the analysis of genomic data. Courses have been given for audiences with backgrounds in either biology or statistics. All {{2}} (lectures and computer labs) are available on this site. There is also a {{3}} to consolidate Bioconductor-focused training materials and establish a community of Bioconductor trainers.
templates.zh: Bioconductor 项目围绕基因组数据分析的软件与统计方法开设了{{1}}。课程面向具有生物学或统计学背景的听众。所有{{2}}（讲座与上机实验）都可在本站获取。此外还有一个{{3}}，用于整合以 Bioconductor 为重点的培训材料，并建立 Bioconductor 培训者社区。

templates.pat: Users are encouraged to become developers, either by contributing {{1}} or documentation. Additionally Bioconductor provides a mechanism for linking together different groups with common goals to foster collaboration on software, often at the level of shared development.
templates.zh: 鼓励用户成为开发者，无论是贡献{{1}}还是文档。此外，Bioconductor 还提供机制，把目标相同的不同团队连接起来，以促进软件协作，往往是在共享开发的层面上。
